title: Research method for Liu_2022_eGFR
bodyHtml:
These results were generated in the study:

Epigenomic and transcriptomic analyses define core cell types, genes and targetable mechanisms for kidney disease.
Liu H, et al.
Nat Genet. 2022 Jul;54(7):950-962. doi: 10.1038/s41588-022-01097-w.
PMID: 35710981

Putative effector genes for kidney function were prioritized at 878 independent loci that were genetically associated with eGFRcrea at genome-wide significance (p < 5e-8) in a GWAS meta-analysis with 1,508,659 subjects, about 80% of whom were of European ancestry. The following data types were generated using human kidney tissue:

  • expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs)
  • methylation quantitative trait loci (meQTLs) and expression quantitative trait methylation (eQTM) analysis
  • Bayesian colocalization of eQTLs with eGFRcrea-associated SNPs
  • Multiple-trait colocalization of meQTLs, eQTLs, and eGFRcrea-associated SNPs
  • Summary data-based Mendelian randomization (SMR)
  • Heterogeneity in dependent instruments (HEIDI) to distinguish pleiotropy from linkage
  • Enhancer-gene links predicted using the activity-by-contact (ABC) model
  • Single cell co-accessibility analysis using the Cicero method, applied to the eGFRcrea GWAS SNPs and kidney snATAC-seq data

Priority scores represent the number of evidence types supporting each prediction, and range from 8 to 1.

Access a complementary view of these results in an interface created by the Susztak lab.
